name: How much does it cost to hire a general contractor for a home remodel?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to hire a general contractor for a home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of hiring a general contractor varies significantly based on the project's scope, complexity, materials chosen, and regional labor rates. General contractor fees typically range from 10% to 20% of the total project cost. This fee covers their overhead, project management, insurance, and profit. For an accurate estimate, it's essential to have a detailed discussion about your specific project requirements, as contractors provide custom quotes rather than fixed prices.
acceptedAnswer.description: General contractor costs vary based on project scope, materials, and complexity, typically ranging from 10% to 20% of the total project cost.
